package domain

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"reflect"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const HybridConsequenceSchema = "planner-hybrid-consequence.v1"
const HybridOutcomeNoChange = "NO_CHANGE"
const HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded = "REPLAN_NEEDED"
const HybridApplicationAuto = "AUTO"
const HybridApplicationRequiresIntent = "REQUIRES_INTENT"

type HybridScopeIdentity struct {
	GoalCode      string   `json:"goal_code"`
	DirectionCode string   `json:"direction_code"`
	DesiredStacks []string `json:"desired_stacks"`
}

type HybridFutureMutation struct {
	Kind           string `json:"kind"`
	ItemID         string `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	TargetPosition *int   `json:"target_position,omitempty"`
	TemplateItemID string `json:"template_learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	NewItemID      string `json:"new_learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
}

type HybridRequestedChange struct {
	Scope     HybridScopeIdentity    `json:"scope"`
	Mutations []HybridFutureMutation `json:"mutations"`
}

type HybridLearningIntentProjection struct {
	IntentID             string                `json:"intent_id"`
	StudentID            string                `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID       string                `json:"learning_path_id"`
	ExpectedPathRevision int64                 `json:"expected_path_revision"`
	Kind                 string                `json:"kind"`
	RequestedChange      HybridRequestedChange `json:"requested_change"`
	CreatedAt            time.Time             `json:"created_at"`
}

type HybridConsequence struct {
	Schema               string                 `json:"schema"`
	ConsequenceID        string                 `json:"consequence_id"`
	StudentID            string                 `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID       string                 `json:"learning_path_id"`
	ExpectedPathRevision int64                  `json:"expected_path_revision"`
	SnapshotRef          string                 `json:"snapshot_ref"`
	SnapshotTargets      []LearningTargetRef    `json:"snapshot_targets"`
	PolicyVersion        string                 `json:"policy_version"`
	PolicyInputHash      string                 `json:"policy_input_hash"`
	Outcome              string                 `json:"outcome"`
	ApplicationMode      string                 `json:"application_mode,omitempty"`
	ReasonCodes          []string               `json:"reason_codes"`
	BaselineScope        HybridScopeIdentity    `json:"baseline_scope"`
	DesiredScope         HybridScopeIdentity    `json:"desired_scope"`
	Mutations            []HybridFutureMutation `json:"mutations"`
	IntentID             string                 `json:"intent_id,omitempty"`
	RequiredIntentKind   string                 `json:"required_intent_kind,omitempty"`
}

const HybridReplanPolicyVersion = "hybrid-replan-v1"
const HybridApplicationApplied = "APPLIED"
const HybridApplicationNoChange = "NO_CHANGE"
const HybridApplicationWaitingSafeBoundary = "WAITING_SAFE_BOUNDARY"

var (
	ErrHybridStale          = errors.New("hybrid snapshot stale")
	ErrHybridIntentRequired = errors.New("hybrid learner intent required")
	ErrHybridConflict       = errors.New("hybrid semantic conflict")
	ErrHybridUnsafe         = errors.New("hybrid unsafe mutation")
	ErrHybridUnsupported    = errors.New("hybrid unsupported mutation")
)

type HybridLearningIntentReceipt struct {
	Intent                  HybridLearningIntentProjection `json:"intent"`
	PayloadHash             string                         `json:"payload_hash"`
	Status                  string                         `json:"status"`
	CommittedAt             time.Time                      `json:"committed_at"`
	ConsumedAt              *time.Time                     `json:"consumed_at,omitempty"`
	ConsumedByConsequenceID string                         `json:"consumed_by_consequence_id,omitempty"`
}
type HybridApplicationReceipt struct {
	ConsequenceID     string    `json:"consequence_id"`
	PayloadHash       string    `json:"payload_hash"`
	LearningPathID    string    `json:"learning_path_id"`
	PreviousRevision  int64     `json:"previous_revision"`
	ResultingRevision int64     `json:"resulting_revision"`
	Status            string    `json:"status"`
	CommittedAt       time.Time `json:"committed_at"`
}

func hybridApplicationUUID(s string) bool { return IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(s) }
func hybridApplicationDigest(s string) bool {
	if len(s) != 71 || !strings.HasPrefix(s, "sha256:") || s != strings.ToLower(s) {
		return false
	}
	b, e := hex.DecodeString(s[7:])
	return e == nil && len(b) == 32
}
func HybridConsequenceID(sid, pid, ref, policy string) string {
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte("planner-hybrid-consequence.v1\x00"+sid+"\x00"+pid+"\x00"+ref+"\x00"+policy)).String()
}
func validateHybridScope(s HybridScopeIdentity) error {
	code := func(v string) bool { return len(v) > 0 && len(v) <= 128 && v == strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(v)) }
	if !code(s.GoalCode) || !code(s.DirectionCode) || s.DesiredStacks == nil || len(s.DesiredStacks) > 100 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	for i, v := range s.DesiredStacks {
		if !code(v) || (i > 0 && v <= s.DesiredStacks[i-1]) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return nil
}

var hybridApplicationReasons = map[string]bool{"NO_SIGNIFICANT_CHANGE": true, "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_QUALITY": true, "UNSTABLE_MASTERY": true, "CONFIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT": true, "TARGET_MASTERED_STABLE": true, "NO_RELEVANT_FUTURE_ITEMS": true, "EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP": true, "EXPLICIT_LEARNER_INTENT": true, "REQUIRES_LEARNER_INTENT": true}
var hybridApplicationIntentKinds = map[string]bool{"CHANGE_GOAL": true, "CHANGE_DIRECTION": true, "CHANGE_TRACK": true, "CHANGE_TECH_STACK": true, "SUBSTANTIAL_SCOPE_CHANGE": true, "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY": true, "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY": true, "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT": true}

func validateHybridApplicationMutation(m HybridFutureMutation) error {
	if !hybridApplicationUUID(m.ItemID) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	switch m.Kind {
	case "SKIP_REDUNDANT_PENDING_ITEM", "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT":
		if m.TargetPosition != nil || m.TemplateItemID != "" || m.NewItemID != "" {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS":
		if m.TargetPosition == nil || *m.TargetPosition < 0 || *m.TargetPosition > 499 || m.TemplateItemID != "" || m.NewItemID != "" {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM", "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY":
		if !hybridApplicationUUID(m.TemplateItemID) || m.ItemID == m.TemplateItemID || m.TargetPosition != nil || m.NewItemID != "" {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION":
		if !hybridApplicationUUID(m.TemplateItemID) || !hybridApplicationUUID(m.NewItemID) || m.TargetPosition == nil || *m.TargetPosition < 0 || *m.TargetPosition > 499 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return ErrHybridUnsupported
	}
	return nil
}
func ValidateHybridConsequence(c HybridConsequence) error {
	if c.Schema != HybridConsequenceSchema || !hybridApplicationUUID(c.StudentID) || !hybridApplicationUUID(c.LearningPathID) || c.ExpectedPathRevision < 1 || !hybridApplicationDigest(c.SnapshotRef) || !hybridApplicationDigest(c.PolicyInputHash) || c.PolicyVersion != HybridReplanPolicyVersion || c.ConsequenceID != HybridConsequenceID(c.StudentID, c.LearningPathID, c.SnapshotRef, c.PolicyVersion) || c.Mutations == nil || len(c.Mutations) > 500 || len(c.ReasonCodes) == 0 || validateHybridScope(c.BaselineScope) != nil || validateHybridScope(c.DesiredScope) != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	targets, e := NormalizePlanningSnapshotTargets(c.SnapshotTargets)
	if e != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(targets, c.SnapshotTargets) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	for i, r := range c.ReasonCodes {
		if !hybridApplicationReasons[r] || (i > 0 && r <= c.ReasonCodes[i-1]) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	ids := map[string]bool{}
	newids := map[string]bool{}
	for i, m := range c.Mutations {
		if validateHybridApplicationMutation(m) != nil || (i > 0 && m.ItemID <= c.Mutations[i-1].ItemID) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		ids[m.ItemID] = true
	}
	for _, m := range c.Mutations {
		if m.NewItemID != "" {
			if ids[m.NewItemID] || newids[m.NewItemID] {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			newids[m.NewItemID] = true
		}
	}
	switch c.Outcome {
	case HybridOutcomeNoChange:
		if c.ApplicationMode != "" || len(c.Mutations) != 0 || c.IntentID != "" || c.RequiredIntentKind != "" || !reflect.DeepEqual(c.BaselineScope, c.DesiredScope) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded:
		switch c.ApplicationMode {
		case HybridApplicationAuto:
			if len(c.Mutations) == 0 || c.IntentID != "" || c.RequiredIntentKind != "" || !reflect.DeepEqual(c.BaselineScope, c.DesiredScope) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			for _, m := range c.Mutations {
				if m.Kind == "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" || m.Kind == "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" || m.Kind == "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT" {
					return ErrValidation
				}
			}
		case HybridApplicationRequiresIntent:
			if !hybridApplicationUUID(c.IntentID) || !hybridApplicationIntentKinds[c.RequiredIntentKind] || (len(c.Mutations) == 0 && reflect.DeepEqual(c.BaselineScope, c.DesiredScope)) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		default:
			return ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func HybridConsequencePayloadHash(c HybridConsequence) (string, error) {
	if e := ValidateHybridConsequence(c); e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	return planningSnapshotDigest(c)
}
func ValidateHybridLearningIntent(p HybridLearningIntentProjection) error {
	if !hybridApplicationUUID(p.IntentID) || !hybridApplicationUUID(p.StudentID) || !hybridApplicationUUID(p.LearningPathID) || p.ExpectedPathRevision < 1 || p.CreatedAt.IsZero() || !hybridApplicationIntentKinds[p.Kind] || validateHybridScope(p.RequestedChange.Scope) != nil || p.RequestedChange.Mutations == nil || len(p.RequestedChange.Mutations) > 500 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if p.Kind == "CHANGE_TRACK" {
		return ErrHybridUnsupported
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	newids := map[string]bool{}
	for _, m := range p.RequestedChange.Mutations {
		if e := validateHybridApplicationMutation(m); e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if seen[m.ItemID] {
			return ErrHybridConflict
		}
		seen[m.ItemID] = true
	}
	for _, m := range p.RequestedChange.Mutations {
		if m.NewItemID != "" {
			if seen[m.NewItemID] || newids[m.NewItemID] {
				return ErrHybridConflict
			}
			newids[m.NewItemID] = true
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func ValidateHybridLearningIntentProjection(p HybridLearningIntentProjection, s StudentPlanningSnapshot) error {
	if e := ValidateHybridLearningIntent(p); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if p.StudentID != s.StudentID || p.LearningPathID != s.LearningPathID || p.ExpectedPathRevision != s.Path.Version {
		return ErrHybridStale
	}
	return nil
}
func HybridLearningIntentPayloadHash(p HybridLearningIntentProjection) (string, error) {
	if e := ValidateHybridLearningIntent(p); e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	p.CreatedAt = time.Time{}
	p.RequestedChange.Mutations = cloneHybridApplicationMutations(p.RequestedChange.Mutations)
	sort.Slice(p.RequestedChange.Mutations, func(i, j int) bool {
		return p.RequestedChange.Mutations[i].ItemID < p.RequestedChange.Mutations[j].ItemID
	})
	return planningSnapshotDigest(p)
}
func cloneHybridApplicationMutations(in []HybridFutureMutation) []HybridFutureMutation {
	out := append([]HybridFutureMutation{}, in...)
	for i := range out {
		if out[i].TargetPosition != nil {
			v := *out[i].TargetPosition
			out[i].TargetPosition = &v
		}
	}
	return out
}
func hybridApplicationScope(s StudentPlanningSnapshot) HybridScopeIdentity {
	return HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: append([]string{}, s.Profile.DesiredStacks...)}
}
func cloneHybridPath(p StudentLearningPath) StudentLearningPath {
	p.Items = cloneHybridSlice(p.Items)
	for i := range p.Items {
		p.Items[i] = cloneHybridItem(p.Items[i])
	}
	return p
}
func cloneHybridItem(i LearningPathItem) LearningPathItem {
	i.Targets = cloneHybridSlice(i.Targets)
	i.FrozenRequirements = cloneHybridSlice(i.FrozenRequirements)
	i.LessonContent = cloneHybridSlice(i.LessonContent)
	return i
}
func cloneHybridSlice[T any](input []T) []T {
	if input == nil {
		return nil
	}
	output := make([]T, len(input))
	copy(output, input)
	return output
}
func hybridPathMatchesSnapshot(s StudentPlanningSnapshot, p StudentLearningPath) bool {
	if s.StudentID != p.StudentID || s.LearningPathID != p.ID || s.Path.CourseID != p.CourseID || s.Path.GoalCode != p.GoalCode || s.Path.CourseFingerprint != p.CourseFingerprint || s.Path.PolicyVersion != p.PolicyVersion || s.Path.PlannerPolicyVersion != p.PlannerPolicyVersion || s.Path.Status != p.Status || s.Path.Version != p.Version || len(s.Path.Items) != len(p.Items) {
		return false
	}
	for n, i := range p.Items {
		w := s.Path.Items[n]
		targets := append([]LearningTargetRef{}, i.Targets...)
		sortPlanningTargets(targets)
		if w.ID != i.ID || w.Position != i.Position || w.Status != i.Status || w.ReferenceType != i.ReferenceType || w.ReferenceID != i.ReferenceID || w.LessonRevisionID != i.LessonRevisionID || !reflect.DeepEqual(w.Targets, targets) || !PlanningSnapshotCanonicalEqual(w.FrozenRequirements, append([]LessonRequirement{}, i.FrozenRequirements...)) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func hybridProtectedApplicationItems(s StudentPlanningSnapshot, p StudentLearningPath) (map[string]bool, int) {
	protected := map[string]bool{}
	boundary := -1
	for _, i := range p.Items {
		if i.Status != LearningPathItemPlanned {
			protected[i.ID] = true
			if i.Position > boundary {
				boundary = i.Position
			}
		}
		for _, r := range i.FrozenRequirements {
			if r.Satisfied {
				protected[i.ID] = true
			}
		}
	}
	for _, f := range s.ActivityFacts {
		protected[f.ItemID] = true
	}
	for _, b := range s.CourseBindings {
		if b.LifecycleStatus == "OPEN" {
			protected[b.LearningPathItemID] = true
		}
	}
	for _, b := range s.PracticeBindings {
		if b.LifecycleStatus == PracticeLearningActionOpen || b.LifecycleStatus == PracticeLearningActionReserved {
			for _, i := range p.Items {
				if i.ID == b.LearningPathItemID || (b.LearningPathItemID == "" && i.ReferenceType == "practice" && i.ReferenceID == b.TaskRevisionID) {
					protected[i.ID] = true
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for _, i := range p.Items {
		if i.Position <= boundary {
			protected[i.ID] = true
		}
	}
	return protected, boundary
}
func hybridHasOpenApplicationBinding(s StudentPlanningSnapshot) bool {
	for _, item := range s.Path.Items {
		if item.Status == LearningPathItemInProgress {
			return true
		}
	}
	for _, b := range s.CourseBindings {
		if b.LifecycleStatus == "OPEN" {
			return true
		}
	}
	for _, b := range s.PracticeBindings {
		if b.LifecycleStatus == PracticeLearningActionOpen || b.LifecycleStatus == PracticeLearningActionReserved {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func hybridIntentScopeKind(p HybridLearningIntentProjection, baseline HybridScopeIdentity) error {
	desired := p.RequestedChange.Scope
	switch p.Kind {
	case "CHANGE_GOAL":
		if desired.GoalCode == baseline.GoalCode || desired.DirectionCode != baseline.DirectionCode || !reflect.DeepEqual(desired.DesiredStacks, baseline.DesiredStacks) {
			return ErrHybridConflict
		}
	case "CHANGE_DIRECTION":
		if desired.DirectionCode == baseline.DirectionCode || desired.GoalCode != baseline.GoalCode || !reflect.DeepEqual(desired.DesiredStacks, baseline.DesiredStacks) {
			return ErrHybridConflict
		}
	case "CHANGE_TECH_STACK":
		if reflect.DeepEqual(desired.DesiredStacks, baseline.DesiredStacks) || desired.GoalCode != baseline.GoalCode || desired.DirectionCode != baseline.DirectionCode {
			return ErrHybridConflict
		}
	case "CHANGE_TRACK":
		return ErrHybridUnsupported
	case "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT":
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(desired, baseline) || len(p.RequestedChange.Mutations) != 1 || p.RequestedChange.Mutations[0].Kind != p.Kind {
			return ErrHybridConflict
		}
	}
	if reflect.DeepEqual(desired, baseline) && len(p.RequestedChange.Mutations) == 0 {
		return ErrHybridConflict
	}
	return nil
}
func ValidateHybridLearningIntentForCreation(s StudentPlanningSnapshot, p StudentLearningPath, intent HybridLearningIntentProjection) error {
	if _, err := NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(s); err != nil {
		return ErrHybridStale
	}
	if e := ValidateHybridLearningIntentProjection(intent, s); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if !hybridPathMatchesSnapshot(s, p) || p.Status != LearningPathStatusActive {
		return ErrHybridStale
	}
	if e := hybridIntentScopeKind(intent, hybridApplicationScope(s)); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	// Recording an exact learner request is distinct from accepting its state
	// transition. Cancellation has no supported Student terminal state yet, but
	// the meaningful request still belongs in durable owner intent history.
	if intent.Kind == "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" {
		operation := intent.RequestedChange.Mutations[0]
		for _, item := range p.Items {
			if item.ID == operation.ItemID {
				if item.Status == LearningPathItemReady || item.Status == LearningPathItemInProgress {
					return nil
				}
				return ErrHybridUnsafe
			}
		}
		return ErrHybridConflict
	}
	_, _, e := planHybridMutations(s, p, intent.RequestedChange.Mutations, true)
	return e
}
func ValidateAndPlanHybridApplication(s StudentPlanningSnapshot, p StudentLearningPath, c HybridConsequence, intent *HybridLearningIntentProjection) (StudentLearningPath, string, error) {
	unchanged := cloneHybridPath(p)
	if e := ValidateHybridConsequence(c); e != nil {
		return unchanged, "", e
	}
	if _, e := NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(s); e != nil {
		return unchanged, "", ErrHybridStale
	}
	if !hybridPathMatchesSnapshot(s, p) || c.StudentID != p.StudentID || c.LearningPathID != p.ID || c.ExpectedPathRevision != p.Version || c.SnapshotRef != s.References.SnapshotRef || !reflect.DeepEqual(c.SnapshotTargets, s.RequestedTargets) || !reflect.DeepEqual(c.BaselineScope, hybridApplicationScope(s)) {
		return unchanged, "", ErrHybridStale
	}
	// All owner target facets influencing this path must be in the coherent
	// requested set. The repository fences precisely this set with mastery locks;
	// an otherwise valid subset snapshot cannot authorize a partial fence.
	covered := map[string]bool{}
	for _, target := range c.SnapshotTargets {
		covered[targetIdentity(target)] = true
	}
	require := func(targets []LearningTargetRef) bool {
		for _, target := range targets {
			if !covered[targetIdentity(target)] {
				return false
			}
		}
		return true
	}
	for _, item := range p.Items {
		if !require(item.Targets) {
			return unchanged, "", ErrHybridStale
		}
	}
	for _, binding := range s.CourseBindings {
		if !require(binding.LearningTargets) {
			return unchanged, "", ErrHybridStale
		}
	}
	for _, binding := range s.PracticeBindings {
		if !require(binding.LearningTargets) {
			return unchanged, "", ErrHybridStale
		}
	}
	if c.Outcome == HybridOutcomeNoChange {
		return unchanged, HybridApplicationNoChange, nil
	}
	if p.Status != LearningPathStatusActive {
		return unchanged, "", ErrHybridUnsafe
	}
	major := c.ApplicationMode == HybridApplicationRequiresIntent
	if major {
		if intent == nil {
			return unchanged, "", ErrHybridIntentRequired
		}
		if s.PendingIntent == nil || !PlanningSnapshotCanonicalEqual(*s.PendingIntent, *intent) {
			return unchanged, "", ErrHybridIntentRequired
		}
		if e := ValidateHybridLearningIntentForCreation(s, p, *intent); e != nil {
			return unchanged, "", e
		}
		ops := cloneHybridApplicationMutations(intent.RequestedChange.Mutations)
		sort.Slice(ops, func(i, j int) bool { return ops[i].ItemID < ops[j].ItemID })
		if intent.IntentID != c.IntentID || intent.Kind != c.RequiredIntentKind || !reflect.DeepEqual(intent.RequestedChange.Scope, c.DesiredScope) || !reflect.DeepEqual(ops, c.Mutations) {
			return unchanged, "", ErrHybridIntentRequired
		}
		if hybridHasOpenApplicationBinding(s) {
			return unchanged, HybridApplicationWaitingSafeBoundary, nil
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(c.DesiredScope, c.BaselineScope) {
			return unchanged, "", ErrHybridUnsupported
		}
	}
	for _, m := range c.Mutations {
		if m.Kind == "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION" {
			found := false
			for _, r := range c.ReasonCodes {
				found = found || r == "EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP"
			}
			if !found {
				return unchanged, "", ErrHybridUnsupported
			}
		}
	}
	planned, waiting, e := planHybridMutations(s, p, c.Mutations, major)
	if e != nil {
		return unchanged, "", e
	}
	if waiting {
		return unchanged, HybridApplicationWaitingSafeBoundary, nil
	}
	if reflect.DeepEqual(planned.Items, p.Items) {
		return unchanged, "", ErrHybridConflict
	}
	planned.Version = p.Version + 1
	return planned, HybridApplicationApplied, nil
}
func planHybridMutations(s StudentPlanningSnapshot, p StudentLearningPath, ops []HybridFutureMutation, major bool) (StudentLearningPath, bool, error) {
	result := cloneHybridPath(p)
	protected, boundary := hybridProtectedApplicationItems(s, p)
	indexes := map[string]int{}
	reserved := map[string]bool{}
	for n, i := range p.Items {
		if !hybridApplicationUUID(i.ID) || reserved[i.ID] {
			return result, false, ErrHybridConflict
		}
		indexes[i.ID] = n
		reserved[i.ID] = true
	}
	waiting := false
	authorizedReady := map[string]bool{}
	for _, m := range ops {
		n, ok := indexes[m.ItemID]
		if !ok {
			return result, false, ErrHybridConflict
		}
		i := p.Items[n]
		active := m.Kind == "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" || m.Kind == "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" || m.Kind == "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT"
		if active {
			if !major {
				return result, false, ErrHybridUnsafe
			}
			if i.Status != LearningPathItemReady && i.Status != LearningPathItemInProgress {
				return result, false, ErrHybridUnsafe
			}
			if m.Kind == "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT" {
				known := false
				for _, b := range s.PracticeBindings {
					known = known || (b.SurfaceClassification == "project" && (b.LifecycleStatus == PracticeLearningActionOpen || b.LifecycleStatus == PracticeLearningActionReserved) && (b.LearningPathItemID == i.ID || (b.LearningPathItemID == "" && i.ReferenceType == "practice" && b.TaskRevisionID == i.ReferenceID)))
				}
				if !known {
					return result, false, ErrHybridUnsupported
				}
			}
			if m.Kind == "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" {
				tn, ok := indexes[m.TemplateItemID]
				if !ok || !hybridApplicationFrozenTemplate(s, p.Items[tn]) {
					return result, false, ErrHybridUnsupported
				}
				started := hybridHasOpenApplicationBinding(s) || i.Status != LearningPathItemReady
				for _, r := range i.FrozenRequirements {
					started = started || r.Satisfied
				}
				for _, fact := range s.ActivityFacts {
					started = started || fact.ItemID == i.ID
				}
				if !started {
					authorizedReady[i.ID] = true
					continue
				}
			} else if !hybridHasOpenApplicationBinding(s) && i.Status == LearningPathItemReady {
				return result, false, ErrHybridUnsupported
			}
			waiting = true
			continue
		}
		if protected[i.ID] || i.Status != LearningPathItemPlanned {
			return result, false, ErrHybridUnsafe
		}
	}
	if waiting {
		future := []HybridFutureMutation{}
		for _, op := range ops {
			if op.Kind != "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" && op.Kind != "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" && op.Kind != "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT" {
				future = append(future, op)
			}
		}
		if _, _, err := planHybridMutations(s, p, future, false); err != nil {
			return result, false, err
		}
		return result, true, nil
	}
	type insertion struct {
		position int
		item     LearningPathItem
	}
	insertions := []insertion{}
	moves := map[int]LearningPathItem{}
	sources := map[int]bool{}
	for _, m := range ops {
		n := indexes[m.ItemID]
		old := result.Items[n]
		switch m.Kind {
		case "SKIP_REDUNDANT_PENDING_ITEM":
			result.Items[n].Status = LearningPathItemSkippedMastered
		case "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS":
			destination := *m.TargetPosition
			if destination >= len(p.Items) || destination == old.Position || protected[p.Items[destination].ID] || p.Items[destination].Status != LearningPathItemPlanned {
				return result, false, ErrHybridUnsafe
			}
			if _, ok := moves[destination]; ok {
				return result, false, ErrHybridConflict
			}
			moves[destination] = old
			sources[old.Position] = true
		case "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM", "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION", "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY":
			tn, ok := indexes[m.TemplateItemID]
			if !ok {
				return result, false, ErrHybridConflict
			}
			template := p.Items[tn]
			if !hybridApplicationFrozenTemplate(s, template) {
				return result, false, ErrHybridUnsupported
			}
			replacement := cloneHybridItem(template)
			replacement.Status = LearningPathItemPlanned
			for k := range replacement.FrozenRequirements {
				replacement.FrozenRequirements[k].Satisfied = false
			}
			if m.Kind == "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM" || m.Kind == "REPLACE_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" {
				a := append([]LearningTargetRef{}, old.Targets...)
				b := append([]LearningTargetRef{}, template.Targets...)
				sortPlanningTargets(a)
				sortPlanningTargets(b)
				if m.Kind == "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM" && !reflect.DeepEqual(a, b) {
					return result, false, ErrHybridUnsupported
				}
				replacement.ID = old.ID
				replacement.Position = old.Position
				replacement.Status = old.Status
				replacement.ReasonCode = old.ReasonCode
				result.Items[n] = replacement
			} else {
				if reserved[m.NewItemID] || *m.TargetPosition <= boundary || *m.TargetPosition < old.Position || *m.TargetPosition > len(p.Items) || len(p.Items)+len(insertions) >= 500 {
					return result, false, ErrHybridConflict
				}
				reserved[m.NewItemID] = true
				replacement.ID = m.NewItemID
				insertions = append(insertions, insertion{*m.TargetPosition, replacement})
			}
		default:
			return result, false, ErrHybridUnsupported
		}
	}
	if len(moves) != len(sources) {
		return result, false, ErrHybridConflict
	}
	for position := range moves {
		if !sources[position] {
			return result, false, ErrHybridConflict
		}
	}
	for position, item := range moves {
		item.Position = position
		result.Items[position] = item
	}
	sort.Slice(insertions, func(i, j int) bool {
		if insertions[i].position != insertions[j].position {
			return insertions[i].position < insertions[j].position
		}
		return insertions[i].item.ID < insertions[j].item.ID
	})
	if len(insertions) > 0 {
		out := []LearningPathItem{}
		k := 0
		for n := 0; n <= len(result.Items); n++ {
			for k < len(insertions) && insertions[k].position == n {
				out = append(out, insertions[k].item)
				k++
			}
			if n < len(result.Items) {
				out = append(out, result.Items[n])
			}
		}
		result.Items = out
		for n := range result.Items {
			result.Items[n].Position = n
		}
	}
	for n, i := range p.Items {
		if protected[i.ID] && !authorizedReady[i.ID] && !reflect.DeepEqual(i, result.Items[n]) {
			return result, false, ErrHybridUnsafe
		}
	}
	return result, false, nil
}
func hybridApplicationFrozenTemplate(s StudentPlanningSnapshot, i LearningPathItem) bool {
	if i.ReferenceType == "lesson" {
		return i.LessonRevisionID != "" && len(i.FrozenRequirements) > 0 && ValidateLessonAssignment(i) == nil && len(i.LessonContent) > 0 && json.Valid(i.LessonContent)
	}
	if i.ReferenceType == "practice" {
		for _, b := range s.PracticeBindings {
			if b.TaskRevisionID == i.ReferenceID && hybridApplicationDigest(b.TaskRevisionDigest) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}
